name: Hayah
description: Hayati (My Life in Arabic) is A UAE-focused family WebApp bringing budgets, bills, savings goals, and meaningful occasions together in one shared space.

paragraphs: Hayati (حياتي) literally means “My Life” in Arabic, and that's what our app is all about - making life a little easier for you and your family.
A family’s money story is made up of everyday choices and meaningful milestones. Hayati brings them into one shared view - so the whole family can plan what’s next with more clarity.
features: Family Dashboard : See household spending, savings progress, upcoming expenses, and financial priorities in one place.
Budgeting & Expense Tracking : Organize spending by category, set budget limits, and understand where your money goes.
Savings Goals : Set targets for family priorities, track contributions, and follow progress over time.
Family Calendar : Plan important dates alongside their expected costs, with a clearer view of upcoming financial commitments.
Bills & Debt Planning : Keep track of recurring payments, upcoming bills, and debt repayment strategies.

whatItDoes.text: Hayati (حياتي) literally means “My Life” in Arabic, and that's what our app is all about - making life a little easier for you and your family.

requirements.text: Note: This is a prototype, so no actual login credentials are required.
Hayati AI requires a valid Gemini API key; the rest of the prototype can be explored without one.
